objectives.description: Definition of home management; careers in home management.
The management process: planning, organization, implementation, evaluation; application of process to specific tasks.
Motivations for home management: personal characteristics, values, goals, standards, needs, events.
Family resources: definition, characteristics, kinds — human (time, energy, skill, work simplification as it applies to the home), non-human/material, community resources.
Decision-making: definition and process of decision-making.

subStrands.name: Family Types, Marriage, Courtship and Parenthood

objectives.description: The family: definition; types — nuclear, monogamous, polygamous, extended; advantages and disadvantages of each type; family life cycle — beginning, expanding, contracting and empty-nest; functions of the family; roles and responsibilities of family members (mother, father, children, working mothers, single parent etc.); family relationship — husband and wife, parent/child, sibling/sibling; factors affecting family relationship; conflict and conflict resolution.

Courtship and marriage: types of marriage; boy/girl relationship — definition, traditional/custom, guidelines for healthy boy/girl relationship, problems of unhealthy boy/girl relationship, consequences of indiscriminate sexual indulgence, sex education; choosing a life partner — factors to consider (blood group, genotype, HIV status), dating, courtship, engagement; preparation for marriage — readiness (where to live, maturity, finances), introduction to each other's family; marriage ceremony in different localities.

Parenthood: preparation for parenthood — planning a family, reproduction, pregnancy, ante-natal care; child birth — labour, delivery, post-natal care, immunization; parenting — meaning, importance, responsibilities (provision of needs, bathing etc.).

subStrands.name: Nutrients, Meal Planning, Food Preparation and Preservation

objectives.description: Nutrients and nutrition: functions, sources and effects of deficiency of nutrients (carbohydrates, proteins, fats and oils, vitamins, minerals, water and roughage).
Meal planning: factors to consider in meal planning; planning balanced meals for different members of the family; special meals for the sick, elderly, and children; budgeting for food.
Food preparation and cooking: methods of cooking food; preparation of local and continental dishes; food hygiene and safety practices.
Food preservation and storage: reasons for food preservation; methods of food preservation (traditional and modern); storage of foods.

subStrands.name: Housing, Home Equipment, Textiles and Consumer Education

objectives.description: Housing: factors to consider when choosing a house; types of housing; planning of rooms; sanitation and maintenance of the home.
Home equipment and furnishings: selection, use, care, maintenance and storage of home equipment and furnishings.
Textiles and clothing: types of fibre and fabric; selection and care of clothing; laundry — equipment and processes.
Consumer education: meaning of consumer; rights and responsibilities of a consumer; consumer protection; budgeting and management of family income.
Entrepreneurship in home management: setting up a home-based enterprise; business plan; marketing of home management products and services.
